objectives_fil: Bumuo ng before-work checklist para sa station at field visit na may supplies, ruta, reporting contact at malinaw na dahilan kung kailan magpa-pause.
objectives_en: Build a before-work checklist for station work and field visits covering supplies, route, reporting contact and explicit pause conditions.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ihanda ang kontrol at kagamitan; iulat ang kulang bago magsagawa ng hindi ligtas na gawain.
sections.takeaway_en: Prepare controls and equipment; report gaps before undertaking unsafe work.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang ligtas na ruta at malinaw na reporting contact ay kasinghalaga ng listahan ng bibisitahin.
sections.takeaway_en: A safe route and clear reporting contact matter as much as the visit list.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kapag magkakasabay ang hazards, kailangang baguhin ang gawain at humingi ng tamang desisyon.
sections.takeaway_en: Combined hazards may require changing the work and obtaining the appropriate decision.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang checklist ay dapat may desisyon kung ligtas nang magsimula, hindi listahan lamang ng gamit.
sections.takeaway_en: A checklist must support a decision about safe starting conditions, not just list equipment.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang checklist ay dapat may desisyon kung ligtas nang magsimula, hindi listahan lamang ng gamit.
sections.takeaway_en: A checklist must support a decision about safe starting conditions, not just list equipment.

check.prompt_fil: May banta sa ruta ngunit mahaba pa ang visit list. Ano ang ligtas na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: There is a threat on the route but many visits remain. What is safe?

options.fil: Iwasan ang banta at ayusin ang alternatibo kasama ang supervisor.
options.en: Avoid the threat and arrange an alternative with the supervisor.

options.fil: Huwag ipaalam ang pagbabago ng ruta upang hindi makaabala.
options.en: Change the route without telling anyone to avoid disruption.

check.feedback_fil: Ang ikalawang sagot ay inuuna ang ligtas na paraan at koordinasyon. Ang visit target ay hindi dahilan upang pumasok sa banta; kailangan pa ring alam ang ruta at oras ng balik.
check.feedback_en: The second response secures a safe approach and coordination. Visit targets do not justify entering danger; the route and return time still need to be known.
